system_configurations.name: RCCL-Validate-MI455X-TDM-NaN
system_configurations.description: Functional validation of the gfx1250 TDM path of the NaN-flag protocol. Builds with --enable-tdm-nan and runs the unit suite under NCCL_PROTO=NaN with RCCL_TDM_NAN_MIN_BYTES=0, so every NaN primitive op, however small, moves through the tensor data mover.

tests.name: TDM_NaN_Ring_AllReduce
tests.description: AllReduce under forced Ring + NaN with the TDM path built in

tests.name: TDM_NaN_AlltoAll
tests.description: AlltoAll under NCCL_PROTO=NaN, whose intra-node send/recv halves take the NaN p2p kernel

tests.name: TDM_NaN_Tree_AllReduce
tests.description: AllReduce under forced Tree + NaN with the TDM path built in

tests.name: TDM_NaN_SentinelEscape
tests.description: All-ones payload dwords are escaped on every collective with a NaN kernel, on the register and TDM paths

tests.name: TDM_Capability
tests.description: Fails when the SDK cannot build the tensor data mover, which would otherwise compile the TDM NaN path away and leave the suites below covering nothing

tests.name: TDM_NaN_BuildFlag
tests.description: Fails when --enable-tdm-nan did not reach the build, which would leave every suite below on the register path

tests.name: TDM_NaN_FifoDepth
tests.description: NaN FIFO sizing and selection with ENABLE_TDM_NAN compiled in, including the deeper TDM step

test_suites.name: TDM NaN - Toolchain capability
test_suites.description: Guards the suites below: a build without tensor-data-mover support makes them vacuous

test_suites.name: TDM NaN - Build flag
test_suites.description: Guards the suites below: a build without --enable-tdm-nan makes them vacuous

test_suites.name: TDM NaN - Sentinel escape
test_suites.description: Device escape checks on a TDM-enabled build

test_suites.name: TDM NaN - Ring
test_suites.description: Unit suite under forced Ring + NaN on a TDM-enabled build

test_suites.name: TDM NaN - Tree
test_suites.description: Unit suite under forced Tree + NaN on a TDM-enabled build
